indicator_name: Currency weights of the import-weighted NEER (previous year's import shares), percent
description: Веса валют в NEER по структуре импорта предыдущего года, %
methodology: Dated the year the weights are used in NEER_IMPORT_WEIGHTED (shares of the previous year's imports). Items BASKET.CURRENCY and COVERAGE_BASKET = share of the basket's imports from partners with a currency in the index.
